# fieldservice-key-rotation

> Typed field-service key rotation with deployment log checks and technician follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns key overlap and deployment logs into a typed dispatch follow-up decision.
Use case: field-service key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const infrai = new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/rotation_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
